node.title: L1 deep exact-shell Johnson closure
node.statement: For any Reed-Solomon code and agreement m with m^2>n(k-1), the ordinary list size is at most floor(n(m-k+1)/(m^2-n(k-1))). At m_J=floor((n+k-1)/2)+1 the denominator is positive, so the entire list is at most n^2. Every exact shell with 2m>n+k-1 lies in that one threshold list; hence all deep exact shells together cost at most n^2, or 2^88 over the full prize box n<=2^44. This is a polynomial L1 payment, not an exact finite-reserve claim. The balanced band is not counted.
